Retain the complete original gray cloth fields, brown clothing/vest fields, dark blue-black lower regions and all soft washed patches at identical UV and original physical pattern scale. Keep every source dark field equally dark: no invented neck anatomy, skin features or objects, no extra garment closures.

The nine chain openings are genuinely source-alpha0, while the dark belt interior is alpha255. Follow the actual full source alpha mask everywhere, never infer transparency from black RGB or material name. Keep the existing transparent margins/islands and the existing opaque black areas. Do not add transparency or remove opaque dark cloth.

Only refine existing soft painted transitions and very fine matte paint grain. Retain the subdued relative palette, gray/brown cloth vs leather identity, broad source shading and boundary exposure. No coarse noise, curls, hatching, repeating weave, photographic leather pores, glossy bevels, embroidery, new folds, extra seams, colored halo, sharper bright rims or stronger metal glints. Undefined source micro-marks remain indistinct. No text, symbols, extra details or redesign. Output only this complete faithful material atlas.
